title: 谷歌新经理培训：把管理价值观变成日常行动
topic: 谷歌新经理培训：把管理价值观变成日常行动

source.title: [re:Work] Google's New Manager Training Slides - Google スライド
source.section: How Do Your Values Show Up? (Mindset & Values)
source.license: 原文按项目方确认的授权收录
source.context: 原文出自 Google re:Work 公开的 New Manager Training Slides。本课选取 Mindset & Values 部分关于谦逊、征求反馈和承认未知的片段。
paragraphs: Briefly, think of a time when you led or made a decision from your highest principles & values in the past (hint: grey areas & unprecedented situations)
Consider the example of Humility as a value. How might this show up in your choices and behaviors as a manager?
Be open to and ask for feedback often
Actively seek opportunities to give & share credit
Share personal stories of mistakes or failures
Admit when you don't know something
Adopt mindset of being in service to team
translations: 简要回想一次你曾依据重要原则和价值观来带领团队或作出决定的经历（提示：想想灰色地带或前所未有的情形）。
以“谦逊”为例，想想它会如何体现在你的管理选择和行为中。
保持开放，主动并经常征求反馈。
主动寻找机会给予认可并分享功劳。
分享自己犯错或经历失败的故事。
在自己不了解某件事时坦承这一点。
以服务团队为出发点来调整自己的管理心态。

notes.meaning: 最重要的原则和价值观
notes.explain: 提示学习者回想价值观如何影响过去真实的带队或决策行为。
notes.example: I used my values to guide the decision when the deadline changed.

notes.phrase: show up in your choices and behaviors
notes.explain: show up in 指抽象的价值如何在具体行为中体现。
notes.example: Respect can show up in how a manager asks for input.

notes.explain: ask for feedback 表示主动邀请他人指出可改进之处。
notes.example: I ask for feedback after each project review.

notes.phrase: Admit when you don't know something
notes.meaning: 承认自己有不了解的地方
notes.explain: admit 后可接 when 引导的从句；承认不确定并不等于放弃处理问题。
notes.example: I don't know the full context yet, so I will check before I answer.

notes.phrase: Adopt mindset of being in service to team
notes.meaning: 以服务团队为出发点调整管理心态
notes.explain: 这里强调经理把团队需要纳入自己的选择，而不是只强调个人权威。
notes.example: A manager can ask what would help the team move forward.

scenario.title: A new manager responds without guessing
english: Maya has recently moved from an individual contributor role into team management.
A teammate asks why a senior leader approved a change to the reporting process, but Maya has not seen the full rationale.
Maya says she does not want to guess, asks what concerns the teammate has, and commits to checking with the decision owner by 3 p.m.
chinese: Maya 最近从个人贡献者转为团队经理。
一位同事问一项由高级负责人批准的汇报流程调整为何这样安排，但 Maya 还没看到完整背景。
Maya 表示自己不想猜测，询问同事有哪些顾虑，并承诺在下午 3 点前向决策负责人核实后回复。

firstAttempt.prompt: 团队成员问一项由其他负责人决定的流程调整为什么这样定；你还不知道完整背景。请用 2–3 句英文说明你不想猜测、邀请对方说出顾虑，并承诺具体回复时间。
firstAttempt.sample: I haven't seen the full rationale yet, so I don't want to guess. What concerns do you have? I'll check with the decision owner and get back to you by 3 p.m.
firstAttempt.rationale: 先坦承信息边界，再听取同事的顾虑并明确跟进时间，把谦逊和倾听落到可执行的管理动作上。

words.example: A manager can show humility by admitting what they do not know.
words.translation: 经理可以通过承认自己不了解的地方来体现谦逊。
words.note: 这里指愿意承认知识边界并保持开放，不是贬低自己的能力。

words.example: A learning mindset makes it easier to ask for feedback.
words.translation: 学习型心态有助于主动征求反馈。
words.note: 可用于描述一个人面对学习、改变或挑战时的思考方式。

words.example: I asked the team for feedback before finalizing the plan.
words.translation: 敲定计划前，我征求了团队的意见。
words.note: feedback 通常作不可数名词；表示具体意见时也可说 a piece of feedback。

words.example: A good manager can admit when they need more information.
words.translation: 优秀的经理可以坦言自己还需要更多信息。
words.note: 后面可以接 that 从句，也可以接 when 引导的从句。

words.example: Could you explain the rationale for the schedule change?
words.translation: 你能解释一下调整日程的决策依据吗？
words.note: rationale 比 reason 更强调支撑某项决定或做法的逻辑。

words.collocation: follow up with someone by a time
words.example: I'll follow up with the team and share an update tomorrow morning.
words.translation: 我会继续向团队核实，并在明早同步进展。
words.note: 作动词短语时 follow up 分开写；名词 follow-up 通常加连字符。

structure.original: How might this show up in your choices and behaviors as a manager?
analysis: Consider the example… 是祈使结构，邀请读者思考一个例子。
of Humility as a value 说明讨论对象是作为价值观的“谦逊”。
How might this show up… 是含情态动词 might 的疑问句，询问某个价值可能如何体现。
show up in 在这里表示“体现在……中”。
your choices and behaviors 中 choices 与 behaviors 并列，指决策和可观察的行动。
structure.transfer: When you do not know an answer, what could you say to your team, and when would you follow up?

rewrite.bad: I approved the change. Just follow the plan.
rewrite.good: I haven't seen the full rationale yet, so I don't want to guess. What concerns do you have? I'll check with the decision owner and get back to you by 3 p.m.
rewrite.translation: 我还没有看到完整的决策依据，所以不想猜测。你有哪些顾虑？我会向决策负责人核实，并在下午 3 点前回复你。
rewrite.pattern: I haven't seen the full [context / rationale] yet, so I don't want to guess. What [concerns / risks] do you have? I'll check with [person] and get back to you by [time].

cloze.prompt: I haven't seen the full ___ yet, so I don't want to guess.
cloze.why: rationale 指支撑这项决定的理由或依据。

cloze.prompt: What ___ do you have about the process change?
cloze.why: What concerns do you have? 用来询问对方的顾虑。

cloze.prompt: I'll check with the decision owner and get back to you ___ 3 p.m.
cloze.why: by 3 p.m. 表示不晚于下午 3 点。

dictation.text: I haven't seen the full rationale yet, so I don't want to guess.
What concerns do you have? I'll check with the decision owner and get back to you by 3 p.m.

apply.prompt: 同事指出你拟定的上线计划可能没有考虑客服团队的排班。你还没核实最新日程。请承认自己需要确认，询问对方具体担心什么，并说明回复时间。
apply.sample: I haven't checked the support team's schedule yet, so I don't want to guess. What timing issue do you think we should address? I'll review it with the team and get back to you by noon tomorrow.

translationPractice.prompt: 我还没有看到完整的决策依据，所以不想猜测。
translationPractice.answer: I haven't seen the full rationale yet, so I don't want to guess.
translationPractice.why: 先说明信息边界，避免把未经核实的内容说成事实。

translationPractice.prompt: 你对这项流程调整有哪些顾虑？
translationPractice.answer: What concerns do you have about the process change?
translationPractice.why: 用开放式问题邀请对方说明具体担忧。

translationPractice.prompt: 我会向决策负责人核实，并在下午 3 点前回复你。
translationPractice.answer: I'll check with the decision owner and get back to you by 3 p.m.
translationPractice.why: check with 说明核实对象；by + 时间明确跟进期限。

choice.prompt: 同事问一项流程调整的依据，而你还没看过完整说明。请选择既诚实回应、又能听取顾虑并明确后续的表达。
options: I haven't seen the full rationale yet, so I don't want to guess. What concerns do you have? I'll check with the decision owner and get back to you by 3 p.m.
The decision is final, so there is no need to discuss it.
I don't know. Ask someone else.
choice.why: 第一项说明信息边界、邀请同事表达顾虑，并承诺核实后回复；另外两项分别压制讨论和推开责任。

output.prompt: 产品同事问你为什么上线时间推迟；你知道仍有几项背景待确认。请用英文说明自己不会猜测，询问对方最关心什么，并承诺一个明确的回复时间。
output.sample: I don't know the full reason for the delay yet, so I don't want to speculate. What is your main concern? I'll confirm the timeline with the team and get back to you by 2 p.m.
check: 是否说明目前还缺少哪些信息？
是否邀请对方说明具体顾虑？
是否给出明确的核实动作和回复时间？

taskPhrases.collocation: I haven't seen the full + context / rationale / plan yet.
taskPhrases.example: I haven't seen the full rationale yet, so I don't want to guess.
taskPhrases.translation: 我还没有看到完整的决策依据，所以不想猜测。

taskPhrases.collocation: What concerns / risks / questions do you have about…?
taskPhrases.example: What concerns do you have about the process change?
taskPhrases.translation: 你对这项流程调整有哪些顾虑？

taskPhrases.word: I'll check with… and get back to you by…

taskPhrases.collocation: check with + person; get back to someone by + time
taskPhrases.example: I'll check with the decision owner and get back to you by 3 p.m.
taskPhrases.translation: 我会向决策负责人核实，并在下午 3 点前回复你。
